data.narrative:
Somos is a Series B housing and construction company that has raised $105.6M to date. The valuation universe consists of four private peers in adjacent frontier-tech construction segments (Plantd Materials, Cuby Technologies, Cover, and Charge Robotics), with no direct public comparables available for triangulation.

The stage-progression method is applicable to this investment. Using total capital raised ($106M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of $201M. This single-method approach establishes a median point estimate; a sensitivity range around this central case, holding methodology constant, produces a low bound of $171M and a high bound of $231M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $171M to $231M, centered at $201M. Key uncertainties include the limited comp set (four private peers only, no public references) and reliance on a single triangulation method. Stage-progression multiples are sensitive to market conditions and exit timing expectations. Stronger conviction on this range would require either direct comparable transaction data from the peer set or revenue- or growth-rate–based approaches, neither of which are available in the present dataset. The median estimate should be stress-tested against downside scenarios in construction sector activity and funding environment tightening.
